I must now compute and print the number of valid completed orders from LOYAL customers (i.e., the size of the filtered DataFrame) and the mean revenue, using code that actually prints them.

I will:
- Re-run the filtering and conversion.
- Print the count of valid orders.
- Print the mean revenue.
- Then submit.

function.arguments:
{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Drop rows with NaN revenue
filtered_df = filtered_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Print the count of valid orders
print("Number of valid completed orders from LOYAL customers:", len(filtered_df))

# Print the mean revenue
print("Mean revenue:", filtered_df['revenue'].mean())"}
